name: ridgeback-tool-gate
description: Gate a proposed tool call by request, role and safe mode: run/confirm/refuse plus matches_request, permitted, irreversible, identity_arg, other_household, child_limit, risk.
serving: verdict refuse or other_household/child_limit high -> block the call; irreversible or verdict confirm -> ask the person first. The dispatcher's gates are still the enforcement point; this is triage in front of them.
